verdict.rationale: Customer support is a fair question for a business account product, but nothing in the evidence documents live, always-available support for urgent account issues. The Cases API is an asynchronous partner channel for opening and responding to support queries, not live support at any hour. One community report describes support promising a reply 'within 30 days', which points away from live help.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
